ACCESS: every www.ox.ac.uk URL tried (course page, english-language-requirements, fees rates, robots.txt) returns HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge ('Just a moment...') to the normal user agent; not bypassed. English, fees and funding live only on www.ox.ac.uk, so they stay unknown. Joint degrees Mathematics and Computer Science and Computer Science and Philosophy are related, not the programme.

english.notes: Access failure: the University's English language requirements page (www.ox.ac.uk/admissions/undergraduate/applying-to-oxford/english-language-requirements) returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to the normal user agent; not bypassed. gpa.notes: Offers are qualification-specific (A-level/IB) on the central course page, which returned 403. Department prose: 'Our standard conditional offer is based on 3 A-levels' (FAQ); shortlisting uses the TMUA with 'no "pass" mark' (how_to_apply). No GPA threshold.

deadline.quote: The strict submission deadline for submitted your completed UCAS application is 6pm (UK time) on 15 October
deadline.notes: Year not printed; for October 2027 entry the UCAS deadline is 15 October 2026 at 6pm UK time, already past on the research date. One UCAS round for all applicants including international ('All applicants apply through UCAS by the mid October deadline'). 'Late applications cannot be accepted.' TMUA registration and sitting also required.
